episodes.title: The Death Row Convict and the Executioner
episodes.summary: Gabimaru the Hollow has been sentenced to death. Carrying out that sentence, however, may require the services of an extraordinary professional.

episodes.title: Screening and Choosing
episodes.summary: The condemned criminals are gathered on the beach to prepare for the expedition to Shinsenkyo, but first, they must reduce their numbers.

episodes.title: Weakness and Strength
episodes.summary: Gabimaru, Sagiri, and the others arrive on Shinsenkyo, and their battle for survival begins.

episodes.title: Hell and Paradise
episodes.summary: Yuzuriha approaches Gabimaru and Sagiri with an offer.

episodes.title: The Samurai and the Woman
episodes.summary: Gabimaru and Sagiri's group cross paths with another Yamada Asaemon, Genji, who takes a dim view of Sagiri's involvement in the present matter. Meanwhile, Yamada Asaemon Tenza tries to find a way off the island along with his charge, Nurugai.

episodes.title: Heart and Reason
episodes.summary: Rokurota, the Giant of Bizen, attacks Gabimaru and Sagiri's party. Meanwhile, Chobe and Toma's paths cross with another party's while they look for sustenance in the mountains.

episodes.title: Flowers and Offerings
episodes.summary: Chobe and Toma encounter people unlike any they've ever encountered before. Gabimaru and Sagiri's party finally meet people who live on the island.

episodes.title: Student and Master
episodes.summary: Tenza and Nurugai also encounter one of the island's strange denizens with unfathomable power. All seems lost before they encounter another Yamada Asaemon...

episodes.title: Gods and People
episodes.summary: Sagiri's group sets off in search of Horai. Gabimaru goes ahead and encounters the same powerful being that confronted Tenza...

episodes.title: Yin and Yang
episodes.summary: Mei attempts to explain something very important to Sagiri's party in the forest. Shion tries to explain how he interacts with the world to Nurugai. A mysterious servant of the Tensen tries to explain why Aza Chobe and Toma shouldn't escape.

episodes.title: Weak and Strong
episodes.summary: Chobe brings new abilities to bear as he faces the Tensen's servants. A secret of Mei's is revealed to Gabimaru, hardening his resolve to fight and opening him up to a new perception of the world.

episodes.title: Umbrella and Ink
episodes.summary: Mu Dan confronts Sagiri's party and reveals shocking truths about the island's true nature.

episodes.title: Dreams and Reality
episodes.summary: Sagiri's party faces Mu Dan's seemingly unstoppable true form. Shion does his best to rise to the challenge with his mastery of waves.

episodes.title: Dawn and Confusion
episodes.summary: Shugen and Jikka are sent to Shinsenkyo, while Gabimaru and his companions battle Aza Chobe and Toma.

episodes.title: Reality and Fantasy
episodes.summary: Aza Chobe and Gabimaru lose themselves in battle, but Mei stops their fight.

episodes.title: Immutability and Change
episodes.summary: While Aza Chobe battles Rien, Gabimaru regains his memories and begins training in the use of tao.

episodes.title: The Samurai Code and Carnage
episodes.summary: Sagiri believes Shugen will be an ally and eagerly anticipates the expedition's arrival, but Shion is skeptical.

episodes.title: Humans and Sages
episodes.summary: As the expeditioners prepare, Gabimaru asks Mei if she's sure she wants to leave the island with them.

episodes.title: Conflict and Growing Together
episodes.summary: Gabimaru's group finally enters the sacred mountain, but the Tensen can see everything they're up to.

episodes.title: Two People and One Person
episodes.summary: Gantetsusai and Fuchi struggle against Tao Fa, but they seem to be enjoying themselves.

episodes.title: Chrysanthemum and Peach
episodes.summary: When Tao Fa asks Ju Fa for help, Ju Fa recalls the time they spent together.

episodes.title: Love and Karma
episodes.summary: The expeditioners work together to take on Tao Fa and Ju Fa, who have undergone Kishikai transformations.

episodes.title: Master and Student
episodes.summary: Shion and Nurugai take on Zhu Jin, but both sides lack the ability to finish the other off.

episodes.title: Ephemeralness and Fire
episodes.summary: Gabimaru recalls the days he spent with Yui. How will his battle against Rien end?

episodes.title: Endings and Beginnings
episodes.summary: As Gabimaru and his companions finish their respective battles, the additional expedition arrives.
